meta.name: wireframe-generator
meta.description: Generate comprehensive UI/UX wireframes with component specifications, API interactions, and responsive behavior notes. Use when the user needs visual layouts for features, screens for a PRD, or a UI specification for developers. Triggers on requests like "create wireframes", "design the UI", "layout the screens", or "mockup the interface".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将需求转成线框图和界面规格说明
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要把产品想法画成页面级线框图再交给设计和开发。
copy.tagline_en: Turn feature ideas into clear wireframes with interaction and responsive notes.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to turn product ideas into page-level wireframes for design and development teams.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会把功能需求或文档转化成详细的低保真线框图（文本/ASCII 格式），标明布局、组件、加载/空/错误状态、API 数据绑定和点击交互，供开发人员直接实现。
howto.when: 当你说“create wireframes”“design the UI”等请求，或需要功能视觉布局、PRD 的屏幕、面向开发者的 UI 规范时触发。

say.text: 帮我为登录页生成线框图，包含加载和错误状态。
say.note: 会生成对应的文本线框图文档。

say.text: 根据这份 PRD，生成所有屏幕的线框图。
say.note: Claude 会读取 PRD 并输出各屏幕线框图。

say.text: 设计一个移动端优先的仪表盘界面线框图。
say.note: 会按移动端优先的布局生成。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude turns functional requirements or documents into detailed low-fidelity wireframes (text/ASCII) that specify layout, components, loading/empty/error states, API data binding, and click interactions for developers to implement.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user says "create wireframes", "design the UI", or similar, or needs visual layouts for features, PRD screens, or UI specs for developers.

say_en.text: Generate a wireframe for the login page with loading and error states.
Create wireframes for all screens based on this PRD.
say_en.note: Reads the PRD and generates screen wireframes.

say_en.text: Design a mobile-first dashboard interface wireframe.
